summary: Amphenol Corporation filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for the issuance of €600 million 3.375% Senior Notes due 2029 and €500 million 3.875% Senior Notes due 2034. The notes are being offered by a syndicate of underwriters, with closing expected May 12, 2026. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction (debt shelf takedown) and does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. There are no special-situation dynamics to monitor.
